_reviewerNote: DANGER — this is the R1 silent-wrong-heal case made concrete. Step 4 healed from the a11y-id 'loginButton' to '//XCUIElementTypeButton[1]' at confidence 0.41 with no floor, no screenshot corroboration, no human confirm, and no neverHeal guard. If [1] happened to be a 'Sign Up' or 'Forgot Password' button on a build where Login was renamed, the test would still PASS and the verdict would read clean — a false green on an auth-critical flow. Compare O3, where healPolicy.healConfidenceFloor=0.90 + humanConfirmOnCriticalPaths=['auth'] + screenshotCorroborated=true would have blocked this heal and forced a human look. O2 has none of those controls; that is why it is compliance-fatal if mistaken for production.
